This Way Out.name: This Way Out
This Way Out.description: The user reads where the danger is moving (the spread of smoke, the direction a villain faces, the surge of a crowd) and calls out a way to safety that avoids it in a clear, steady voice. Everyone who hears the user stops panicking and takes that route, and the danger the user read does not reach the route while they are on it; a new danger, such as a second villain, can. Cost: none.
